job: Show the one state a screen or a section is in: loading, ready, empty, error, no access and the rest.
purpose: A pattern and a wrapper with no box of its own. Its direct children name the states they belong to in data-when; data-state on the wrapper shows them. Nine states: loading (skeletons), ready, empty (first use), filtered, error (with a request ID and Try again), no-access (who can grant it), not-found, off (who can turn it on) and expired. setState or a data-fd-set-state button switches it and fires fd:change.
useWhen: Any screen or section that loads its own data.
A page reached from a link that can be gone, forbidden or out of date.
An area a team can switch off.

avoidWhen.when: A table's own empty, loading and error rows inside its frame.
A swap from skeleton to content with no other states.
A warning above content that loaded.

states.name: loading
states.how: data-state="loading"; the loading part holds skeletons and aria-busy="true"

states.name: error
states.how: data-state="error"; an fd-empty data-tone="danger" role="alert" with an fd-empty-meta request ID

states.name: no access
states.how: data-state="no-access"; an fd-empty-meta names who can grant it

variants.useWhen: The content shows; the default when data-state is absent.
First use: nothing exists yet; say what will appear and give the action.
A filter or a search hides everything; offer Clear filters.
The record in the address does not exist; link to its list.
The area is switched off for this team; say who can turn it on.
A link ran out; say when, and how to get a new one.

parts.role: The wrapper; it adds no box, so it can switch whole bands.
